criterion: No visible formula errors (#REF!, #DIV/0!, #VALUE!, #N/A, #NAME?) anywhere in the workbook
Negative numbers are displayed in parentheses, not with minus signs
Gridlines are hidden on the presentation tab
Hardcoded inputs are sourced (cell comments noting the filing and date)
The comp set is a defensible selection of recent large-cap midstream M&A precedents and includes the marquee deals a board would expect (e.g. ONEOK / Magellan, Energy Transfer / Crestwood)
Enterprise value is built bottom-up as equity market cap (offer value) plus net debt, not lifted from a headline transaction figure
Both EV / EBITDA and Price / Distributable Cash Flow (P / DCF) are computed; P/DCF is an equity-side multiple (equity value over distributable cash flow)
Each target's leverage (Net Debt / EBITDA) and interest coverage are shown to support the EV bridge
Premiums are calculated to the target's unaffected price one trading day before announcement
Summary statistics (min, mean, median, max) are present and correct for the key multiples and the premium
